Sondage.label: Sondages
Sondage.schema: CREATE TABLE sondages (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, options TEXT, active TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, votes TEXT, date DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME, closeDate DATETIME NULL, isMultipleChoice TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, allowOther TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0)
